name: Redwitz an der Rodach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Redwitz an der Rodach (Zollern chequy and a hook on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Redwitz an der Rodach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Redwitz an der Rodach arms — chequy and hook
